# MCP evaluation by a real agent (MCP-16)

The tasks and their outcome checks live in code: `cmd/cm-mcp-eval/tasks.go`
(one entry per task: setup, the text the agent gets, the check against the
manager's state). `last-run.md` is the report of the last real run. How to
run it and how to read it: "Оценка реальным агентом" in `docs/mcp.md`.
